The road grade (slope) at the tapped point, such as "≈+2.5% grade": %1$s is the signed
         percentage without its percent sign (+2.5, -0.8), already formatted for your language; %%
         prints the percent sign. ≈ marks the grade as a smoothed estimate. It is the tooltip's first
         line when the route is coloured by grade, and on its smaller second line when the route is
         coloured by power. The tooltip shortens a line that does not fit with an ellipsis.

The acceleration measured from phone GPS at the tapped point, such as "+0.25 m/s² GPS accel":
         %1$s is the signed acceleration (+0.25, -1.10), already formatted for your language; m/s² is
         metres per second squared. "accel" is short for acceleration, as in maps_route_accel_not_measured.
